capabilities: Start timed sprints with a named decision and finish condition
Watch for epistemic events (claims, sources, assumptions, questions) while writing
End sprints with a review that writes a dated Markdown record
Write daily and weekly summary notes from sprint records
Show a dashboard of recent records and totals
disambiguation: Not an agile project-management sprint tool; it times solo research sessions that must name one decision and a finish condition.
extras: README states the plugin makes no network requests and never moves or renames notes; the author links a free vault at vahtian.com that teaches the underlying Epistemic Notes method.
motivation: The author built it to automate the research changelog part of the Epistemic Notes method, the dated record of when a claim moved and what moved it.
problem: Focus timers only record that you worked for a period; Obsidian has no built-in way to capture what a timed research session actually concluded.
summary: Timed research sprint timer that ends each session with a review note recording claims written, sources linked, assumptions, open questions, and ruled-out paths.
